name: after_short_1280
steps: (() => { const l=document.querySelector('#cards'); l.scrollTop = 140; const before=l.scrollTop; const rows=[...document.querySelectorAll('#cards .card:not(.group)')]; rows[rows.length-1].click(); return { before, after: l.scrollTop, card: document.querySelector('#cards').scrollHeight } })()

name: after_keyboard
steps: (() => { const row=document.querySelectorAll('#cards .card')[2]; row.focus(); row.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',bubbles:true})); return { focused: document.activeElement?.dataset?.nodeId, selected: document.querySelector('#cards .card.selected')?.dataset?.nodeId, tabindex: row.tabIndex } })()

name: after_old_mechanism
steps: (() => { const l=document.querySelector('#cards'); l.scrollTop = 140; const before=l.scrollTop; l.replaceChildren(); const after=l.scrollTop; return { before, after } })()
